description: 3-phase 6-pulse diode bridge: conduction (V_f*I_avg + r_d*I_rms^2) + reverse recovery loss per device

unit.name: Generic 3-phase 6-pulse Diode Bridge Rectifier (20 kW)
unit.source: Mohan, Undeland & Robbins (2003), Power Electronics, 3rd ed., Wiley

V_f.note: Diode forward threshold voltage (fast recovery diode)

E_rr.note: Reverse recovery energy at V_ref/I_ref (50 µJ)

V_ref.note: Reference voltage (peak of 220 V rms phase)
